one_liner: Shopify offers GraphQL and REST APIs with OAuth2 authentication for building ecommerce apps.
gating_notes: Developers can self-serve a free development store for testing. Publishing to the App Store requires a one-time $19 registration fee.
oauth_details: OAuth2 is used for the GraphQL Admin API, typically via token exchange. Access tokens are sent in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header.

auth_methods.quote: To call a Shopify API, your code sends an access token in a request header to authenticate the identity that token represents

credential_access.quote: Credentials) generated through the Partner Account.

api_type.quote: The REST Admin API is a legacy API as of October 1, 2024. Starting April 1, 2025, all new public apps must be built exclusively with the GraphQL Admin API

api_breadth.quote: Extend Shopify's core functionality with apps that integrate into Shopify's admin, online store, checkout and more.

existing_mcp.quote: Shopify MCP lets merchants and partners set up and manage a store through the AI agent of their choice.
